problem_statement: One explicit Start work launches Codex 0.166.0 in the owned native tmux pane, then exits1 with 'Error: timed out discarding buffered terminal input', without a memory ACK. The same literal was reproduced with an actual Windows Terminal sole writer attached before Start.
known_facts: The real-Windows-Terminal-first observation disproves a relay-only explanation. It does not identify the input bytes, exact fatal caller or underlying component.

Managed binary metadata identifies 0.166.0; binary SHA b8a11fedf24b2dfb59a70c9e52b030f9a508dcd49cd2dd0d41956f4c785156b8. No new Codex version command or model process was started during this analysis.
The 0.166.0 and 0.167.0 input_boundary.rs source files have identical Git blob c9a16e579d0681588d2595def5df056ea01052cb. An upgrade has no demonstrated fix for this failure.
A timeout can mean input keeps arriving OR an incomplete control sequence remains quarantined. The error alone does not distinguish these mechanisms.

primary_source_evidence.finding: The drain has a one-second deadline, polls and consumes events, then requires complete buffered-input framing and a non-readable terminal input descriptor.
The app's startup modal drain catches TimedOut and keeps the modal quarantined. This does not establish that every startup caller catches this error.
Onboarding draws then invokes the drain with propagation; a trust-screen transition also propagates it. These are concrete possible fatal callers, not a proven stack for the observed process.
The Unix startup probe has a250ms shared deadline. It emits keyboard/DA1/cursor/OSC10/OSC11 queries and replays retained input through the Crossterm parser.
Completed OSC replies are filtered; incomplete prefixes remain framed for later input.
The exact Codex Cargo patch distinguishes incomplete bracketed paste, OSC, CSI and other control sequences; discard does not bypass an unresolved boundary.

local_code_evidence.finding: NativeRuntime launches a detached native session at120x40 before a later subscribe creates _Channel. _Channel attaches a real private tmux client on a PTY initially120x40; subscribe issues refresh-client. Resize changes that PTY dimensions.

The raw bridge forwards bytes only under control, flushes its own outer input when first gaining control, and deduplicates dimension-based resize frames except an explicit pending request. It does not emulate VT.

The workspace daemon refreshes on a500ms cadence; it respawns the bridge only when run/generation binding changes. A real outer Windows Terminal before Start does not ensure the inner native client is attached before the native program begins its startup probe.

Initial control is sent before queued output; controller changes are deduplicated. The input/output path uses base64 without intentionally adding bytes. No static infinite controller/resize loop is demonstrated.

hypotheses.condition: Nested renderer/control-query responses leave a partial CSI or OSC sequence at the protected input drain.
hypotheses.prediction: The synthetic query collector reports an incomplete control tail or differing complete control classes in the bridge arm.

hypotheses.condition: The detached native program emits its250ms startup query before its inner renderer client exists; attachment arrives later.
hypotheses.prediction: A later controlled timing variant reproduces an incomplete or delayed boundary only when queries precede the inner attach. The currently approved attached-before-query probe does not test this ordering.

hypotheses.condition: Repeated refresh, resize or focus reports keep input readable for the whole one-second drain.
hypotheses.prediction: Counters or event timings show repeated operations/events rather than one initial attach/resize and one controlled resize. Static code deduplicates several of these paths, so no storm is established.

hypotheses.condition: An upstream Crossterm framing/startup defect preserves an incomplete state even when the transport supplies complete replies.
hypotheses.prediction: Transport collection is clean but an exact pinned-Crossterm parser-only reproducer fails on the same synthetic reply framing. No parser-only reproducer has been run.

prepared_probe.trial_definition: One five-query burst with3s total capture per arm; not five individual3s trials.
prepared_probe.transport_test_double: Only the broker WebSocket transport is replaced by an in-process protocol adapter; actual NativeRuntime.subscribe, _Channel, TerminalAttachment and RawTerminalBridge are used.
prepared_probe.geometry: Actual Windows Terminal client remains120x40; each tmux viewport has one controlled120x40_to120x33 resize. The child records actual dimensions independently.
prepared_probe.input_export: Control classes/counts/timing, total byte counts and incomplete-tail class/length only. No raw or printable input strings exported.

does not reproduce the entire Codex input-mode setup
